heading: Today
text: A few passing clouds in the morning, otherwise mostly sunny skies. Highs from the mid to upper 50s. Light and variable wind.

heading: Tonight
text: Mostly clear late, with clouds moving in from the south overnight. Lows in the low to mid 30s, in the upper 30s to low 40s in the Champlain and Saint Lawrence Valleys. Light and variable wind.

heading: Sunday
text: Partly cloudy north, mostly cloudy south, with clouds spreading north with scattered rain showers to follow. Highs in the mid to upper 50s, nearing 60 in the warmest valleys. Wind turning south at 5 to 10 mph.
